title: Scope the fixture docs check to the `-render-fixture` list paragraph instead of the whole document

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Raised by the reviewer in round 1 of ork run ork-20261127-134347-4da8 for S611 (discovered from S611):

Scope the fixture docs check to the `-render-fixture` list paragraph instead of the whole document
CONFIRMED by grep: `docs/design.md:4447` has its own copies of `` `matrix-copy-preview` ``, `` `matrix-copy-ask` `` and `` `matrix-copy-stale-preview` ``. If one of those three is dropped from the fixture list at `docs/design.md:838`, `TestRenderFixtureDocsListEveryFixture/design.md/...` stays green.
The implementer's mutation table (every code span in the whole document replaced) does not cover this case. The slice spec and the 2026-11-27 owner note ask for names "in docs/guide.md and docs/design.md", so the whole-document check meets the contract. This is not a `[fix]`.
A follow-up could cut the paragraph out between fixed openers, as `TestUIPassBriefListsEveryRenderFixture` does (`render_test.go:438-445`).
Importance: 1
Urgency: 1
Effort: 1

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: `internal/cli/render_test.go:459` (`TestRenderFixtureDocsListEveryFixture`); `docs/guide.md:1005` (fixture list and check description); `docs/design.md:834` (fixture list and check description); `landed-changed/S638.md` (via slicer changelog add).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: No new tests specified. Strengthen `TestRenderFixtureDocsListEveryFixture`: removing an exact fixture name only from the -render-fixture list must fail even when the name remains elsewhere in the document. Check missing list boundaries explicitly.
